title: Gcd acceptance policy
description: One policy for one set: contract clauses need machine-checked evidence, acceptance criteria accept property-tested evidence on the sampled domain. The gate (tools/gate.py) runs both backends and decides once over the whole set.

rules.rationale: An acceptance criterion is an empirical claim: a deterministic sample of inputs is the evidence the set asks for (property-tested), never a proof.
The gcd is core domain logic of the example: only machine-checked evidence may accept a contract clause.
